argument: In a multi-machine mobile additive manufacturing system, throughput decreases as the processing time of an additive manufacturing machine increases and as the travel distance of the autonomous mobile robot increases.

claim: In a multi-machine mobile additive manufacturing system, throughput decreases as the processing time of an additive manufacturing machine increases and as the travel distance of the autonomous mobile robot increases.
